name: GitHub
approval: No standard provider review for OAuth app registration
summary: Create a GitHub OAuth app in minutes, but first choose between an OAuth app and a GitHub App. GitHub recommends GitHub Apps for modern integrations because permissions are more granular.

name: Slack
approval: Unlisted: no Marketplace review; Marketplace: up to 10 business days preliminary + up to 10 weeks functional
summary: A Slack app can reach early pilot users through unlisted distribution, but commercial distribution at scale points toward Slack Marketplace approval, with workspace installs and review queues as key blockers.
decision: Launch a controlled pilot through unlisted distribution, then pursue Marketplace listing once you have 10 active workspace installations and production-ready onboarding.

branches.detail: Requires at least 10 installations on active workspaces throughout review and functional/security checks.

summary: Public Notion connections use OAuth 2.0, and can be used without a Marketplace listing. The irreversible choice is installation scope: selected workspaces vs any workspace. Marketplace listing, if chosen, has a separate review.
